utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center — so if you were planning on Saturday, don’t head to the front porch. I’ll keep an ear out for any other updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s been getting a nice turnout, and it’s now Sunday at the community center. If you need anything fixed, I’d mention it soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll pass that update along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks for spreading the word — I really appreciate it! See you Sunday at the community center, and bring anyone who wants to help.

utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Sam — after lunch I’ll swing by the community center and we can check the repair drive together.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Sam — I’ll head over after lunch and meet you at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Kira
